summary: Iteration 15: contract-acceptance gating on /api/bookings + 'A breve disponibile' lock on Stripe/PayPal. ALL 9/9 pytest tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter15_contract.py (~2.0s under `-n 0`; also fine under default `-n 2 --dist loadscope`). FRONTEND verified in-browser at mobile viewport 390x844. Backend (live HTTPS): (1) GET /api/contract -> 200 {version=16-hex 'dbc76f6afbc6958f', lines: [...]}; lines[0] contains 'CONTRATTO DI NOLEGGIO' ('CHIENTIBIKE — CONTRATTO DI NOLEGGIO E-BIKE & GRAVEL'). (2) POST /api/bookings rejections (test user registered, no booking ever created — verified via GET /api/bookings/me returns [] at the end of rejection class): payment_method='stripe' -> 400 'Il pagamento con carta sarà disponibile a breve: scegli il pagamento in negozio'; store without contract_accepted -> 400 'Per prenotare devi accettare il contratto di noleggio'; store with contract_accepted but clauses_approved=false -> 400; same for privacy_accepted=false -> 400; store with all true but contract_version='deadbeef' -> 409 'Il contratto è stato aggiornato: rileggilo e accettalo di nuovo'; store with contract_version=null -> 400 (same gate; the four flags are AND'd). (3) IN-PROCESS success path (httpx.ASGITransport against server.app, server.on_booking_confirmed monkeypatched to async no-op so NOTHING is written to the real Google Sheet and no email is sent): fresh register -> login via Bearer -> POST /api/bookings {payment_method:'store', contract_accepted:true, clauses_approved:true, privacy_accepted:true, contract_version:<real>} -> 200; returned Booking has contract_version==real_version, contract_accepted_at set (ISO), status='confirmed', payment_status='to_pay_in_store'; monkeypatched hook invoked exactly 1x (ensures the integration point is wired); booking doc then deleted DIRECTLY from Mongo + test user deleted; final Mongo state verified (0 docs for both id and email). FRONTEND (register TEST_iter15_fe_<hex>@example.com via /api/auth/register from a page.evaluate fetch to avoid outbound 403, then set JSON-encoded token under localStorage key 'auth_token' — persistToken writes JSON.stringify through secureSet, so a RAW token leads to a parse error warning + logged-out state): bike card -> date 10 days out -> size M -> book-now-button -> /checkout. On /checkout, 390x844: (a) [data-testid='payment-method-store'] is selected by default (border rgb(62,83,67) = brandPrimary; radio shows 'radio-button-on'); (b) [data-testid='payment-method-stripe'] title 'Paga ora con carta' sub 'A breve disponibile'; opacity 0.5; pointerEvents:'none' -> non-selectable (clicking it does not change selection); (c) [data-testid='payment-method-paypal'] title 'PayPal' sub 'A breve disponibile'; opacity 0.5; pointerEvents:'none' -> non-selectable; (d) [data-testid='contract-open'] card BEFORE accept: 'Leggi e accetta il contrattoObbligatorio per completare la prenotazione'; [data-testid='confirm-booking-button'] title BEFORE accept: 'Leggi e accetta il contratto' and tapping it OPENS the ContractModal; (e) modal shows [data-testid='contract-text'] with the real contract (CHIENTIBIKE..., 1. DATI DEL CLIENTE / LOCATARIO, 2. SPECIFICHE MEZZO..., etc.) and three checkboxes [data-testid='contract-consent-contract'|'-clauses'|'-privacy']; [data-testid='contract-accept'] has aria-disabled=true + opacity 0.45 until ALL 3 are ticked (verified: 0/3 -> aria-disabled=true opacity 0.45; 2/3 -> aria-disabled=true opacity 0.45; 3/3 -> aria-disabled=null opacity 1); (f) tapping contract-accept closes the modal; afterwards [data-testid='contract-open'] shows 'Contratto accettatoTocca per rileggerlo' AND [data-testid='confirm-booking-button'] shows 'Conferma prenotazione'. The final confirm button was NOT tapped (safety contract). Note: the confirm button is also gated on phone validity (phone.replace(/\D/g,'').length>=6) and on quote/contract load, so phone MUST be filled before tapping confirm; test filled '3331234567' into [data-testid='checkout-phone-input']. CLEANUP: TEST_iter15_* users deleted post-run, 0 TEST_* bookings in Mongo at end. All data touched is ephemeral TEST_ prefixed. Admin & real bikes untouched. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.create_booking (server.py:366-398): correct order of guards — payment_method=='stripe' gate FIRST (feature-flag via env CARD_PAYMENTS_ENABLED), then AND of 4 consent fields (contract_accepted & clauses_approved & privacy_accepted & contract_version), then version lookup against db.contracts, then availability. Fails fast with correct status codes (400 for consent/method, 409 for version mismatch). Status codes match frontend expectations: Checkout.confirm() specifically catches `e.status===409 && /contratto/i.test(e.message)` to reset acceptedVersion and refetch — tightly coupled but intentional.

server.BookingIn (server.py:149-160): contract_version is Optional[str] with max_length=64 — good; prevents DB bloat. The 4-way AND in create_booking means a missing contract_version short-circuits to 400 'Per prenotare devi accettare il contratto di noleggio' (not 409). That's the correct UX because the client simply hasn't submitted a version — the 409 is reserved for 'you have a version but it is stale'.

contract.get_contract (contract.py:29-51): 10-minute in-memory cache (_cache) is per-process; multiple uvicorn workers would each hit the sheet once. Fine for single-worker deployment. Falls back to the LAST saved contract row in db.contracts if the live sheet is unreachable (len(lines)<3 or HTTP != 200). The version is sha256('\n'.join(lines))[:16] — the regex HEX16 in the test is pinned to this exactly. Note: because get_contract $setOnInsert's new versions, 'deadbeef' will never be present and 409 will always fire — correct.

contract.parse_contract: 'One line per sheet row: non-empty cells joined with two spaces' — the first row of the sheet currently reads 'CHIENTIBIKE — CONTRATTO DI NOLEGGIO E-BIKE & GRAVEL' which satisfies the 'contains CONTRATTO DI NOLEGGIO' test. If the shop renames the heading, update the test (not the backend).

frontend/app/checkout.tsx:84-88: `methods` array hard-codes stripe & paypal as `disabled: true` with sub `t('coming_soon')` — correct. If `CARD_PAYMENTS_ENABLED=true` is later turned on backend-side, the frontend will still mark stripe disabled; a follow-up ticket should wire the backend meta to toggle this. Not a bug today (business ask was to lock both out).

frontend/app/checkout.tsx:142-160: `disabled` on Pressable + `opacity: 0.5` + the 'A breve disponibile' sub-label; computed pointerEvents is 'none' so tapping does nothing. iOS/Android native would need `pointerEvents="none"` on the Pressable; on web React Native sets it from the `disabled` prop. Verified in browser: method state stays 'store' after a forced click on stripe.

frontend/app/checkout.tsx:183: confirm button `onPress={contractOk ? confirm : () => setContractOpen(true)}` — slick 'open modal if not accepted' UX. The visible disabled condition still includes phoneOk & quote; so if the user has no phone yet, tapping does nothing. Minor UX nit: a disabled button gives no feedback. Not blocking.

frontend/src/components/ContractModal.tsx: three independent consent toggles with testIDs contract-consent-contract/-clauses/-privacy; accept button is disabled until ALL three are true (`const all = CONSENTS.every((k) => checked[k])`). On the Checkout parent, `key={contractOpen ? 'open' : 'closed'}` forces a fresh Modal mount each open, which resets the three checkboxes to false — intentional and correct: a user who closes without accepting must re-tick on re-open.

Phone persistence: on successful booking, the backend updates db.users.phone with the submitted phone. This means a logged-in test user accumulates a phone number after a successful booking; the cleanup script deletes TEST_* users to avoid cruft. Not an issue; just documenting the side effect.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (10/10 checks: default store selected; stripe disabled+A breve; paypal disabled+A breve; stripe click does not change selection; contract-open initial text; confirm-button initial title opens modal; contract-text visible with real text; accept disabled 0/3 and 2/3; accept enabled 3/3; after accept both card+button update)

seed_data_creation: All ephemeral TEST_ prefixed. Backend tests created: (a) ONE session-scoped register user `TEST_user_<hex>@example.com` from conftest.user_token fixture (reused for all rejection tests, cancelled & cleaned up by the fixture teardown + a global delete_many after the run); (b) ONE `TEST_iter15_<hex>@example.com` user from the in-process success test — the test itself deletes the user AND the booking it created directly from Mongo before returning (verified empty); (c) frontend run registered 1-2 `TEST_iter15_fe_<hex>@example.com` users (no bookings — confirm was never tapped) — swept by the post-run cleanup script. Final Mongo state confirmed: 0 users matching /iter15/, 0 bookings with user_email like 'TEST_%'. Real Google Sheet NOT written (verified structurally: on_booking_confirmed was monkeypatched, so push_booking + mailer never ran). Admin seeded user admin@noleggionuovo.it + the 4 real Raymon bikes untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iter15_contract.py -n 0 -v` (serial; the in-process ASGI test prefers the default event loop). ~2s runtime. Dependencies: pytest-asyncio (already installed from iter14), requests, httpx, motor — all present. The in-process test imports /app/backend/server which triggers server startup() (motor indexes + seed bikes + background sheet_sync_loop & reminder_loop tasks spin up); harmless but expect those loops to run during the test session. Env vars read at import time: MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, JWT_SECRET, STRIPE_API_KEY, ADMIN_EMAIL, ADMIN_PASSWORD, SHEET_ID (contract fetch), OWNER_ADMIN_EMAILS (owner Google login). CARD_PAYMENTS_ENABLED is NOT set (so stripe gate fires with 400 'a breve'). If a future change flips `CARD_PAYMENTS_ENABLED=true` in backend/.env, test_stripe_rejected will FAIL by design — that is intentional (the test pins the current 'coming soon' behaviour). Frontend ContractModal uses React Native Modal with presentationStyle='pageSheet' — on Expo-web this renders inline, so [data-testid='contract-text'] is reachable by the usual CSS selector. Token persistence on web uses localStorage key 'auth_token' with a JSON.stringify-ed value; writing a raw token causes a console warning and a logged-out state — set `JSON.stringify(token)` not the token itself. SAFETY (unchanged): never tap the final confirm-booking-button in UI tests (writes to the user's REAL Google Sheet via push_booking + mailer), never POST /api/bookings with all consents + real version against the LIVE HTTPS endpoint; only through httpx.ASGITransport with on_booking_confirmed monkeypatched.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all specified behaviours work end-to-end. Minor test-harness notes: (1) Playwright on web needs the auth token stored under localStorage['auth_token'] as JSON.stringify(token) because the app uses a storage wrapper that round-trips through JSON.parse; passing the raw token produced a parse-error warning and the app showed as logged-out. (2) Confirm-booking-button is gated on phoneOk (digit count>=6) in addition to contract state — tests had to fill checkout-phone-input before tapping. (3) Outbound urllib from the automation runner hits a 403 on the preview host, so the test registered the user via page.evaluate fetch to the same origin instead.
